data.one_liner: Performs static analysis of Dart code for tool integration and embedding.
data.what_it_does: Provides a library for performing static analysis on Dart code. It allows developers to configure analysis options, examine elements, and build custom IDE tools, formatters, or documentation generators.
use_when: You are building a custom Dart tool or editor integration
You need to programmatically analyze Dart source code and inspect elements
avoid_when: You just want to run standard linting on your project (use the built-in `dart analyze` command instead)
You are an end-user looking for a command-line analysis tool
strengths: Powers major Dart tooling like dart format and dart doc
Supports fine-grained analysis options and custom lint rules
weaknesses: APIs were originally machine generated from a Java implementation and may not feel like clean Dart APIs
No clean distinction currently between public and internal APIs, leading to potential breaking changes
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally configure an analysis_options.yaml file in your project root.
